notes: לָהֶם is left wholly unrendered, so the preposition and its suffix are each `unrepresented` on their own merits (rule 40).

The *of* before Beth-anath in the last clause is the chain's own relation: בֵית עֲנָת is a second rectum coordinated under the written participle יֹשְׁבֵי, so rule 19 places it and nothing is `added`.
